changelog:
Initial release of DuckDuckGo Search Skill.

- Provides web search functionality using DuckDuckGo for real-time information retrieval.
- Supports text, news, image, video, instant answer, suggestions, and map searches.
- No API key required; privacy-focused and does not track users.
- Includes example scripts for performing and customizing searches in Python.
- Offers configuration for region, safesearch, timelimit, and additional search parameters.
